item.title: Ole Hansen: Next Gold Target is US$6,000, What About Silver?
item.description: Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, believes US$6,000 per ounce is in the cards for gold in the next 12 months; however, silver may not enjoy the same price strength. "If gold moves toward US$6,000, I would believe that ... silver at some point will struggle to keep up, and we'll see basically gold relatively outperform silver," he explained.
